laws.reason: Figma identity and node kind bind emitted identity and source provenance.

laws.reason: Supported paint fields drive emitted CSS/SVG paint and independent paint parity.
Supported effect fields drive emitted CSS/SVG effects and conformance evidence.
Supported text content and typography drive emitted text and CSS.

laws.reason: Supported variable aliases bind source values to the immutable token authority.
Supported alpha-mask identity drives the emitted CSS mask carrier.
